en.headline: SFC plans cybersecurity framework for licensed firms with stricter rules for higher risk
en.dek: Chief Executive Officer Julia Leung outlined the plan at Hong Kong FinTech Week, saying the framework would set baseline requirements and enhanced measures for higher-risk licensed institutions.
body: The Securities and Futures Commission plans to introduce a cybersecurity framework for licensed firms, the regulator’s Chief Executive Officer Julia Leung said at Hong Kong FinTech Week on Monday.

Leung said the framework would establish baseline requirements for all licensed institutions, with higher standards applied to those facing greater risk. She linked the move to the need to strengthen defences against threats that can be amplified by artificial intelligence.

The remarks came as FinTech Week continued at the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre. The SFC has previously issued circulars on AI-enabled cyber risks and related expectations for licensed corporations.

zh.headline: 證監會擬為持牌機構制訂網絡保安架構 風險較高者須符合更高要求
zh.dek: 行政總裁梁鳳儀在香港金融科技周表示，架構會為所有持牌機構訂定基線要求，並對風險較高機構實施加強措施，以應對人工智能相關威脅。
body: 證券及期貨事務監察委員會行政總裁梁鳳儀周一在香港金融科技周表示，證監會計劃為持牌機構制訂網絡保安架構。
梁鳳儀指，架構將為所有持牌機構訂定基線要求，並對風險較高的機構實施更高標準。她表示，此舉是為加強抵禦可能因人工智能而加劇的網絡威脅。
相關言論在香港會議展覽中心舉行的金融科技周期間提出。證監會早前已就人工智能驅動的網絡風險向持牌法團發出通告。
